name: Carry Quintile Sort: Roll Yield Monotonicity Test
description: Does deeper backwardation predict higher next-quarter roll yield in corn and soybeans? Quintile sort on carry (% of front price) using 252-day percentrank. Q1 = deepest contango, Q5 = deepest backwardation. Roll yield = BackwardRatio return - NoAdjustment return (isolates roll component). Outputs: median roll yield by quintile bars, hit rate by quintile bars, and stats table with N/median/hit rate/best/worst per quintile.
source:
# Carry Quintile Sort: Roll Yield Monotonicity Test
# Does deeper backwardation predict higher next-quarter roll yield?
# Quintile sort on carry/price % using 252-day percentrank
# Q1 = deepest contango, Q5 = deepest backwardation
# Roll yield = BackwardRatio return - NoAdjustment return

# --- Data: Two continuations with different adjustments ---
src = market_data_source()()

# BackwardRatio: returns embed roll yield
cont_adj = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# NoAdjustment: pure spot price returns (no roll yield)
cont_raw = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Signal: Carry normalized as % of front price ---
carry = cont_raw.carry
close_raw = cont_raw.c
carry_pct = where(is_valid(close_raw) and close_raw > 0, carry / close_raw)

# --- Roll Yield Isolation ---
# Forward 63-day returns: adjusted (includes roll) vs unadjusted (spot only)
fwd_ret_adj = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_adj.c)
fwd_ret_raw = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_raw.c)
roll_yield_63d = fwd_ret_adj - fwd_ret_raw

# --- Quintile Sort on Carry % (252-day rolling percentrank) ---
# percentrank: 0 = lowest carry in trailing year, 100 = highest
carry_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(carry_pct)

# Quintile buckets: Q1 = deepest contango, Q5 = deepest backwardation
is_q1 = is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 20
is_q2 = is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank > 20 and carry_pctrank <= 40
is_q3 = is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank > 40 and carry_pctrank <= 60
is_q4 = is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank > 60 and carry_pctrank <= 80
is_q5 = is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank > 80

quintile_label = conditional_select(
    is_q1, "Q1 (Deep Contango)",
    is_q2, "Q2 (Contango)",
    is_q3, "Q3 (Neutral)",
    is_q4, "Q4 (Backwardation)",
    is_q5, "Q5 (Deep Backwardation)",
    "Unranked"
)

# --- Roll yield filtered by quintile ---
ry_q1 = where(is_q1, roll_yield_63d)
ry_q2 = where(is_q2, roll_yield_63d)
ry_q3 = where(is_q3, roll_yield_63d)
ry_q4 = where(is_q4, roll_yield_63d)
ry_q5 = where(is_q5, roll_yield_63d)

# --- Hit rate: 1 if positive roll yield, 0 if negative, NaN if no data ---
hit_q1 = where(is_q1 and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q2 = where(is_q2 and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q3 = where(is_q3 and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q4 = where(is_q4 and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q5 = where(is_q5 and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Output 1: Median Roll Yield by Quintile ---
# Punchline: Does roll yield increase monotonically from Q1 to Q5?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title="Is Roll Yield Monotonic Across Carry Quintiles?",
    y_axis_label="Median 63-Day Roll Yield",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category="Carry Quintile Sort",
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q1 Deep Contango", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q2 Contango", color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q3 Neutral", color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q4 Backwardation", color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q5 Deep Backwardation", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(ry_q1, ry_q2, ry_q3, ry_q4, ry_q5))

# --- Output 2: Hit Rate by Quintile ---
# Answers: How reliable is positive roll yield in each bucket?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="How Reliable Is Positive Roll Yield by Quintile?",
    y_axis_label="Hit Rate (% Positive Roll Yield)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    category="Carry Quintile Sort",
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q1 Deep Contango", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q2 Contango", color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q3 Neutral", color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q4 Backwardation", color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Q5 Deep Backwardation", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="50% Coin Flip")
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4, hit_q5))

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per Quintile ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Roll Yield Stats by Carry Quintile",
        row_size=5,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=["Daily Obs (N)", "Median Roll Yield", "Hit Rate (% Positive)", "Best Roll Yield", "Worst Roll Yield"],
        col_headers=["Q1 Deep Contango", "Q2 Contango", "Q3 Neutral", "Q4 Backwardation", "Q5 Deep Backwardation"],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Count
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median roll yield
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (mean of 0/1 series)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best (max)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 4: Worst (min)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Carry Quintile Sort",
    order=3
)(ry_q1, ry_q2, ry_q3, ry_q4, ry_q5, ry_q1, ry_q2, ry_q3, ry_q4, ry_q5, hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4, hit_q5, ry_q1, ry_q2, ry_q3, ry_q4, ry_q5, ry_q1, ry_q2, ry_q3, ry_q4, ry_q5)

# --- Event Markers: Quintile Transitions ---
# Detect when carry percentrank crosses quintile boundaries (20, 40, 60, 80)
crosses_20_up = crossover(carry_pctrank, 20)
crosses_20_dn = crossunder()(carry_pctrank, 20)
crosses_40_up = crossover(carry_pctrank, 40)
crosses_40_dn = crossunder()(carry_pctrank, 40)
crosses_60_up = crossover(carry_pctrank, 60)
crosses_60_dn = crossunder()(carry_pctrank, 60)
crosses_80_up = crossover(carry_pctrank, 80)
crosses_80_dn = crossunder()(carry_pctrank, 80)
is_quintile_flip = crosses_20_up or crosses_20_dn or crosses_40_up or crosses_40_dn or crosses_60_up or crosses_60_dn or crosses_80_up or crosses_80_dn

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Carry Quintile Shift",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="New Quintile", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Carry (% of Price)", dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Percentile Rank", dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="Front Price", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(quintile_label, carry_pct, carry_pctrank, close_raw, is_quintile_flip)
